summary: Iteration 8 covered (1) path-based SEO sitemaps and (2) new /momentos scrollable feed with Amigos/Descubrir toggle. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (sitemap index uses path-based children /sitemap-cities.xml + /sitemap-events-<city>.xml with content-type application/xml and no query-string URLs; sitemap-cities and sitemap-events-{ibiza,madrid} return valid <urlset>; /api/robots.txt returns text/plain with Sitemap: line; SEO regression: /api/ciudad/ibiza returns HTML with class="card", BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD; /api/fiesta/<id> HTML page contains FAQPage + BreadcrumbList; /api/moments/feed?scope=amigos returns only lucia/marc captures with author/image_url/likes/i_liked/event_name; scope=discover returns only sara/tourist and excludes admin; pagination limit=2 returns has_more=true and skip works with no overlap; POST /api/captures/{id}/like toggles i_liked/likes in the feed). Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin@quienva.app/admin123): dismissed onboarding+PushPermissionGate, clicked data-testid=feed-momentos-btn on /feed, navigated to /momentos, verified momentos-toggle-amigos + momentos-toggle-discover, saw 4 amigos cards with moment-like-<id> buttons; like counter went 0->1 optimistically, and Descubrir switch loaded 4 public cards.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~9.5k lines; sitemap + moments endpoints landed in a single monolith. Consider extracting seo/sitemap.py and social/moments.py routers before this grows further.

moments_feed does N+1 lookups (per-capture users + events find_one). For a paginated 20-item feed this is fine, but consider $lookup or a batched find({user_id: {$in: [...]}}, {...}) for authors/events to reduce round-trips.
moments_feed silently coerces unknown scope to 'discover' (line 4116). Consider returning 400 for invalid scope to help clients catch typos.

PushPermissionGate covers the entire feed with z-[100] and blocks pointer events until dismissed — testing agents (and probably real users on desktop browsers with denied notification perms) always hit this. Consider auto-dismissing when Notification.permission==='denied' instead of showing the modal.
test_credentials: admin@quienva.app / admin123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md); seeded users lucia/marc/sara/tourist @ test123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login now redirects to /onboarding on fresh session even though birthdate is set — clicking 'Skip' in the onboarding overlay routes to /feed. After that the PushPermissionGate blocks pointer events until 'Continue anyway' is clicked (button is inside a fixed z-[100] overlay). Then the /momentos entry point is data-testid=feed-momentos-btn in the Feed header. moment-like-<id> is a button whose text content IS the like count (e.g., '0'/'1'), useful for optimistic-update assertions.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
